name_zh: 康托尔-伯恩斯坦-施罗德定理
literal_source_claim: 两个集合互相单射则等势
canonical_claim: For any two sets, if each injects into the other, then there is a bijection between them.

canonical_formal_target.expression: forall {alpha : Type u} {beta : Type v} {f : alpha -> beta} {g : beta -> alpha}, Function.Injective f -> Function.Injective g -> exists h : alpha -> beta, Function.Bijective h
canonical_formal_target.environment_fingerprint: Lean 4.29.0@98dc76e3; mathlib@8a178386; Mathlib.SetTheory.Cardinal.SchroederBernstein sole direct import; full hashes in statement.json

domain_and_universes: Arbitrary carrier types alpha : Type u and beta : Type v, representing sets up to their elements; no finiteness, nonemptiness, decidable equality, or common-universe assumption.
conclusion: There exists h : alpha -> beta such that Function.Bijective h.
alternate_encodings: Given embeddings alpha ↪ beta and beta ↪ alpha, Nonempty (alpha ≃ beta), checked equivalent by Stage1Instances.THM_M_0768.target_iff_bundled.
Mutual cardinal inequalities imply equality of Cardinal.mk values.
degenerate_cases: Empty carriers are included. Mutual injections force both carriers empty when either is empty. No inhabitance hypothesis is permitted.
explicit_exclusions: Bernstein polynomial or Bernstein inequality results

cardinal antisymmetry as a broadened substitute without checked transport
